conf.description: cribl-internal audit log (Leader audit.log via File Monitor Source): 5-key envelope mapped as documented, PLACEHOLDER context keys (user/action/object/file/group/commit/version) mapped exactly as the work order gives them pending confirmation against a real record, event.outcome deliberately not derived since no outcome-bearing field exists in any form here.

conf.comment: cribl-internal/audit/json. HONESTY WARNING per the work order: only the 5-key envelope (time/cid/channel/level/message) is documented -- user/action/object/file/group/commit/version are PLACEHOLDER key names, unconfirmed against a real audit.log record. Implemented exactly as given since that is the work order's own explicit instruction, not an invention, but VALIDATE against a captured record before trusting this. event.action preserves the raw action token per instruction rather than substring-matching a verb out of message. event.outcome is NOT derived -- no outcome-bearing field is given anywhere in this schema, placeholder or otherwise. No masking pattern is given for the 'mask any secret-bearing config value' instruction, so none was implemented (gap, see README). _raw kept as the forensic backstop given the schema uncertainty.

functions.description: document the placeholder-schema honesty warning and the event.outcome/masking gaps
parse the audit.log JSON line into fields
derive _time from the documented ISO 8601 envelope field before it is deleted; @timestamp itself is never targeted per constraint 1; dataset/category tags
batch every clean flat-key field (documented and placeholder alike); 'message' is skipped since its vendor name and ECS target are identical, a no-op rename
delete the now-consumed 'time' envelope key (its ECS target @timestamp cannot be written directly, so _time was already derived from it above)
